required_code_implementation: use the exact limit when appropriate
apply the same discipline to F1 and F2

pb_companion_form.role: exact algebraic reparameterization of K3, not a separate engine

roe1_zero_pb_boundary.prohibited_path: evaluate K3 and then multiply by ROE1

roe2_zero_cancelled_boundary.literal_K3_status: numerically singular and not valid at ROE2=0

n1_zero_still_scales_book.assertion: ROE1, g1 and F1 structure remain boundary-scale inputs even though V_F1 equals zero.

n1_zero_g1_proportionality.condition: n1=0 and every other input is fixed

n2_zero_boundary.interpretation: No full-spread F2 years; transition directly into fade while retaining ROE2, Ke2, g2 and F2 structure.

required_interpretation: negative P/E is not intuitively cheap or expensive
opposite block signs do not automatically indicate an error
loss-to-profit transition occurs at a regime boundary
constant proportional growth cannot cross zero within one phase

rules: each going-concern state uses internally coherent K3 inputs
recovery is residual equity value after debt, costs and senior claims and may equal zero
systematic risk within each state remains in that state's Ke
do not count the same event in both probability and an arbitrary Ke premium
the blend is named Probability-weighted Equity Value and is not named K3
do not report blended P/E unless the earnings base is coherent and the label is derived blended P/E

assertions: a fair-value issuance does not change existing holders' economic value per original share
negative FCFE already reflects the funding requirement
no generic dilution haircut is applied
future fair-value funding shares are not added again to the current-share denominator

country_risk_convention_metadata.formula: Ke = Default-free Risk-free Rate in valuation currency + Bottom-up Beta * Mature-Market ERP + lambda_company * CRP
double_counting_controls: do not add lambda*CRP when the selected ERP already fully embeds country premium without explicit reconciliation
do not count sovereign risk in both the risk-free rate and CRP
keep currency, inflation and nominal/real terms consistent

hurdle_output_label.economic_note: Changing Ke also changes ROE_T, fade and terminal economics inside K3.
hurdle_output_label.true_target_return_solve: freeze the economic trajectory and solve only price/rate outside K3
hurdle_output_label.permitted_operational_use: purchase ceiling conditional on K3 economic conventions
